body:

Just some functions need to be added to enhance the experience:

I deal with tables of contain lot of data, oldies always get confused between columns of rows especially when horizontal scrolling is needed to reach the desire column cell.

2- Multi-selection drop-down list, if we have a list of subjects and we need to assign many value to each subject or record in the sheet (like assigning tags or labels) so we would be able to filter the subject items by tags, I need to be able to assign many values in one cell and be able to filter by them using dropdown multiselection.
